news.title: Clarity Act markup leaves bitcoin unstirred
Bitcoin’s recent $80,000 breakout was led by something other than U.S. spot buyers, data show
news.summary: The rally was led by leveraged traders and not U.S.-based spot buyers. Hence, its. sustainability is being questioned.

news.title: Why bitcoin’s recent climb to $80,000 might just be a temporary liquidity squeeze
news.summary: Spot ETF outflows and a hawkish Federal Reserve are creating a "macro ceiling" that makes a new all-time high unlikely without a major geopolitical shift.
